conbody.p: To work with any version of a contract document associated with a contract record in Conga CLM on Conga Platform, you must open it directly in X-Author for Contracts Advanced. There are two common ways for you to open a document, depending on how you are accessing the document itself. You can open your DOC or DOCX contract document using one of the following methods:

ul.li: Search and open the document in X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
Download the document from Conga CLM on Conga Platform and open it using X-Author for Contracts Advanced.

conbody.p: After opening a document, only one user can work on the document at a time.

note.p: If you are using the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in on MacBook Air, you might see an error message related to “Add-in memory usage” when you work with a document of size 2 MB or more. This is due to a limitation of Microsoft Word. You can continue working after closing this warning message. However, to avoid high memory usage-related issues, you are recommended to close any unused applications on your system while working with X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
